rationale: Final iteration. The best verified design is iteration 7 (score 929.76, 60/60 finishes). Iteration 8 (base_speed 1.2) lost 2 of 20 slalom runs to off-track exits, so speed 1.1 is the safe ceiling. Iteration 10 (ki 0.02 to 0.10) scored 929.42, slightly below iteration 7, so the integral change did not help and is reverted. Iteration 9 was the same design as iteration 7 and confirmed its score. With one race left and an unseen final track, I choose the verified design over an untested change. Its margins are: slalom max_error 0.023 against the 0.06 m off-track limit, and s-bend max_error 0.030. Expected result: about 930, all tracks finishing, one line-loss event per run. Hypotheses not acted on: the line-loss event occurs at the start or finish, so gains alone may not remove it; the s-bend rms_error of about 0.016 is the largest tracking term, and a small kd change could reduce it if oscillation stays low. Measurements requested: completion, progress and completion_time to confirm performance; line_loss_events to locate the loss; max_error and steering_oscillation for margin; rms_error for the s-bend term; controller_errors to confirm no exceptions.
